subject: Next steps: Isolation & deployment preference for HelioHealth (Dedicated vs Private)
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: Isolation expectations for HelioHealth — quick clarifying questions

Hi Priya / Samir,

Thanks again for the conversation today — great context on the PHI requirements and the multi-tenant concerns. Quick recap + two clarifying questions so we can propose a clean path forward: 

Recap (high level)
- Primary requirement: host PHI workloads with no possibility of cross-tenant data leakage; audit logs and KMS-managed keys are required.
- Preferred model: private networking and customer-managed KMS; timeline target: Q3 POC.

Clarifying questions
1) When you say "no cross-tenant access," do you require physical isolation of GPUs (dedicated hardware) or is logical isolation inside our Dedicated offering with strict tenant enforcement acceptable?
2) For the security evidence, which artifacts are a must-have for the initial POC vs. full production (e.g., SOC2 report, network diagrams, HSM/KMS screenshots, encryption-at-rest proof)?

I've attached a short checklist we use to map requirements to deployment options (Private VPC vs Dedicated capacity). If Dedicated can be made to meet your compliance bar for the POC, that could shorten lead time; otherwise Private (VPC or on-prem) is the right posture for production.

Next steps I propose:
- You confirm physical vs logical isolation requirement (Q1).
- We schedule a 30-min technical deep dive with your security/infra contact to walk the checklist (target this week).
- Marissa will prepare an initial solution note and rough timeline & cost for both Private VPC and Dedicated configs we discussed.

Are you available for a technical call Thursday or Friday?

Thanks,
Rishi
Account Exec | Redwood Inference
T: +1 415-555-0183
redwood.ai

- redwood-private-vpc-checklist.pdf (attachment)

From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@heliohealth.com>

Cc: Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@heliohealth.com>
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 09:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: Isolation expectations for HelioHealth — quick clarifying questions

Thanks Rishi — appreciated the summary. Short answers below and a couple of extra constraints from our Security team: 

1) Physical vs logical isolation: for the POC we can accept Dedicated hosts if we get:
   - Tenant-exclusive GPU allocation (no co-tenancy)
   - Dedicated network ACLs + flow logs forwarded to our SIEM
   - Customer-managed KMS with key rotation logs
For production, our preference is Private VPC (VPC peering or PrivateLink into our account) or an on-prem appliance.

2) Security artifacts: for the POC we need: SOC2 Type II (latest), network diagram, KMS integration notes, and a short runbook for incident response and access controls. Full production will require penetration test results and GDPR/DPA addenda if applicable.

Tech contact: I've copied Samir (infra lead) — he'll own setting up the technical deep dive and the security questionnaire. We can do Thursday 10–10:30am PT.

Also: Can you confirm whether Dedicated hosts are available in us-west-2 and approximate lead time to provision for a 2-week POC?

Thanks,
Priya Shah
VP Product & Security Programs | HelioHealth
Priya.Shah@heliohealth.com
+1 617-555-0147

Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 11:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: Isolation expectations for HelioHealth — quick clarifying questions

Hi Priya / Samir,

Thanks — great to have Samir on the thread. Quick answers to your items and an ops-level proposal.

Availability & provisioning
- Dedicated hosts: we do have Dedicated pools in us-west-2. Typical provision time for a reserved Dedicated host set (2 hosts, tenant-exclusive) is ~10 business days; for immediate POC we can provide short-term reserved capacity (subject to availability) or run a >1:1 placement on preemptible capacity if you need same-week. We'll confirm exact availability after the technical deep dive.

Isolation mapping: POC vs Production
- POC (goal: validate PHI handling and integration): Dedicated with tenant-exclusive GPUs + customer KMS + flow logs forwarded to your SIEM. This is the fastest route and keeps the deployment inside Redwood-managed control plane while meeting most of your isolation asks.
- Production (goal: full compliance + long-term control): Private VPC (peering/PrivateLink) or on-prem. Private VPC gives you network boundary control, audit log segregation, and the option to use customer-owned networking appliances.

Required artifacts (we'll prepare):
- SOC2 Type II report (redacted) — attached link.
- Network diagram showing VPC peering/PrivateLink flows (attached PNG).
- KMS integration notes and screenshots for customer-keyed encryption.
- Draft runbook for incident response and access controls (we'll send a version for the POC).

Proposed next steps
1) Technical deep dive with Samir + Redwood SEs (Marissa / Karthik) — Thu 3 Jun, 10:00–10:30 PT (calendar invite to follow).
2) Redwood to provision initial Dedicated hosts estimate for POC and share exact lead times & pricing by EOD Fri.
3) HelioHealth to fill the short security questionnaire (we'll send a prefilled version to speed this).

I've attached the checklist and a one-pager; the checklist maps each security artifact to the deployment option and indicates which items are gated for production.

Speak soon — I'll drop a calendar invite now.

Best,
Marissa Cole
